patterns.note: Full-width sections with generous vertical padding, often featuring asymmetrical content blocks where text is paired with product UI elements or visual examples.
Very large, bold, sans-serif headings in white against dark backgrounds, contrasted with smaller, lighter body text and distinct uppercase labels for categories or sub-headings.

A dominant deep charcoal/near-black background (#0a0a0e) provides a high-contrast canvas for vibrant, saturated accent colors (electric blue, magenta, green, yellow) used for CTAs and graphical elements.

A sticky header transforms on scroll, reducing its height and gaining a solid dark background. The hero section's background image collage exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content.
Content sections and individual elements, such as cards and product UI snippets, animate into view with a subtle fade-up or slide-up motion as they enter the viewport.
Many sections integrate actual product UI screenshots or interactive content examples directly into the design, showcasing the platform's capabilities rather than just describing them.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that dynamically reduces its height and changes its background color from transparent to solid dark upon scrolling past the hero section.
Create a parallax scrolling effect for the hero background image, where it moves slower than the foreground content, likely using GSAP or CSS transforms.
Utilize scroll-triggered animations (e.g., using GSAP ScrollTrigger) to reveal content sections and individual elements with a subtle fade-up or slide-up motion as they enter the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, sans-serif headings (up to ~4-5x body text size) with generous line height, paired with a clear hierarchy of smaller, lighter body and descriptive text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 4-8px) for buttons, cards, and input fields, maintaining a modern, soft-edged feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, particularly in hero and major section introductions, with content grids and card layouts maintaining a consistent, slightly more dense rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive use of its own product UI and content examples as integral design elements, combined with a bold, high-contrast dark theme featuring vibrant, almost neon, accent colors, creates a dynamic and immersive showcase of its capabilities rather than just describing them.
